summary.headline: Warnings on Planetary Configurations
summary.text: Astrological warnings on judging ascendants of beginnings, planetary conjunctions, and oppositions, emphasizing the almuten and chronocrator, with Kushyar al-Hilli cited as an authority. The trine of Jupiter and Saturn signifies royal security and peace, while benefic or malefic configurations and the absence of benefic aspects warn of political outcomes.
